text:
Maddie: Heads-up: sprint to finalize landing hero + two launch social posts + webinar funnel wiring for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Prefer compact hero + one enterprise path. Goal: schedule posts for Tues.

Luis (Design): Dropped three hero comps (sheet link). One is photography-led, one is abstract infra, one is very minimal. My pick: minimal for clarity.

Asha (Content): New micro-props to try under hero (short):
- Same API. Any deployment. No surprises.
- Predictable latency. Predictable spend.
- From POC to production, without ops debt.

Ravi (Growth): For social we need: 1) quick benchmark stat for speed/cost; 2) a human story for product teams (how teams ship). Each should have a 140-char tweet + expanded LinkedIn. Also want UTM: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri_launch_23

Noah (Sales): Webinar signups: include 3 fields: deployment_interest, company_size_band, compliance_flags. If deployment_interest in (Dedicated, Private) and company_size_band is 500+ then tag as "enterprise-leads". Otherwise tag as "self-serve-warm". Also add dropdown "preferred contact window" for SDRs.

Maddie: Agree. Let's make tagging deterministic in the form. Ivy, can we push a hidden field for campaign_id and pass all fields to Segment?

Ivy (Webdev): Yep. I'll add fields: deployment_interest (radio), company_size_band (dropdown), compliance_flags (multi). Will emit Segment.track('webinar_rsvp', {deployment_interest, company_size_band, campaign_id}). ETA 3h.

ops-bot: FYI: Event ingestion limit is 250 req/min per workspace, sustained. Use client-side debounce and server-side dedupe for spikes.

Asha (Content): Draft copies down below. React with :one: for benchmark and :two: for storytelling.

---BENCHMARK (short tweet)---
Asha: "Benchmark: Redwood Inference cuts median response time by ~30% and reduces inference cost per 1M tokens by nearly 2x vs our old stack. See the methodology in the webinar + live Q&A. Register: [link]"

---STORY (short tweet)---
Asha: "How we shipped a production search assistant in 2 sprints: same API, predictable infra, seamless scale. Watch our live demo + migration checklist on the webinar. [link]"

Luis (Design): Hero headline options:
- H1: "Inference that behaves."
- H2: "Same API. Any deployment. Predictable outcomes."
- H3: "Ship with confidence."

Ravi (Growth): LinkedIn expansion for benchmark: include 1-2 bullets calling out tests (chat, rerank), then CTA to webinar and gated benchmark report. Use UTM: ?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=tri_launch_23

Noah (Sales): For leads flagged enterprise, route to "pipeline-enterprise" Slack channel and add priority score: +2 if compliance_flags contains "HIPAA" or "SOC2"; +1 if company_size_band >= 500. We'll triage M-F 9-17.

Ivy (Webdev): I'll map "deployment_interest" values to tags: hosted, dedicated, private. Also add server-side validation to reject empty company_size_band. Will send a test event to Segment staging once wired.

Maddie: CTA decision: primary = "Watch demo" (modal RSVP), secondary = "Download migration checklist" (email). Enterprise CTA = "Request private walkthrough" (form routes to Noah). Any objections?

Luis (Design): No objections. I'll wire button styles: primary purple, secondary ghost.

Asha (Content): Microcopy for modal: headline "See Redwood Inference in action" body "30-min demo + 10-min live Q&A" primary CTA "Reserve my seat" secondary "Send me checklist".

Ravi (Growth): Scheduling notes: post cadence: Tweet + LinkedIn on launch day, reminder email to registrants 24h before, and one day-of live tweet. Also set UTM for emails: ?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=tri_launch_23

ops-bot: Note: If you plan >200 signups/min, enable server-side queueing.

Noah (Sales): I'll create SDR playbook snippet: fields to capture, priority scoring, standard outreach script, sample qualifying questions (compliance, QPS, latency expectations). Will share by EOD.

Asha (Content): Final alt hero microcopy suggestion: "One API. Every deployment. Consistent results."

Maddie: Great. Plan: lock hero variant + CTA by 11:30am. Assets + copy ready by 3pm, dev push after QA. Ivy, ping here when staging event is live. ops-bot, confirm queueing config by 11am.

Ivy (Webdev): Will ping with staging event at ~11:15.

ops-bot: Queueing config set to 500 concurrent tokens; event debounce 2s. Confirmed.

Maddie: Thanks all. I'll schedule posts and the webinar slot. If anything blocks, raise in DMs. :rocket:
